annotations.text:
FMS: the configuration is real and stored, and set to exactly what FMS already does.

It has no impact because it describes the project accurately — not because it is disconnected. Nothing on screen is faked.
The demo payoff is artboard 3, not a toggle that does nothing: two projects with genuinely different ladders, where the difference is visible in navigation, documents and trace rules.
DAL recommends; the project may go stricter or more relaxed. A deviation below the recommendation is recorded with a rationale and an actor, and shown — that is the part an auditor asks about.
